Name: Provide descriptions for visible measures
Description: Every visible measure should have a Description explaining its calculation, business meaning and caveats. Descriptions power tooltips, data dictionaries and are critical for Copilot / Q&A and AI readiness.

Name: Provide descriptions for visible columns
Description: Visible columns should document their business meaning. Column descriptions improve self-service discoverability and help AI tools interpret the model correctly.

Name: Provide descriptions for visible tables
Description: Each visible table should have a Description stating what it represents and its grain (e.g. 'Fact Sales at order-line level'). Grain/purpose documentation is essential for correct analysis and AI interpretation.

Name: Minimize calculated columns (prefer measures or Power Query)
Description: Calculated columns are stored uncompressed-friendly and increase model size. Prefer DAX measures for aggregations and compute static row attributes in Power Query / the source. Review every calculated column to confirm it is necessary.

Name: Avoid bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional cross-filtering adds ambiguity, can hurt performance and may produce incorrect results. Use single-direction (dimension-to-fact) filtering by default; justify and document any bi-directional relationship.

Name: Avoid many-to-many relationships
Description: Many-to-many relationships can degrade performance and introduce aggregation ambiguity. Prefer a one-to-many design with a proper bridge/dimension table where possible.

Name: Use integer keys in relationships
Description: Relationship columns should be whole-number (integer) surrogate keys. String, DateTime or floating-point keys increase cardinality/memory and slow relationship scans. Replace natural text/date keys with integer surrogate keys.

Name: Mark calendar/date tables as a Date table
Description: A dedicated date/calendar table should be marked as a Date table (DataCategory = Time) so time-intelligence DAX works correctly. This flags tables that look like a calendar (contain date columns and are named Date/Calendar) but are not marked.
Expression: DataCategory <> "Time" and Columns.Any(it.DataType = "DateTime") and (Name.IndexOf("Date", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 or Name.IndexOf("Calendar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)

Name: Set data category for geographic columns
Description: Visible columns that represent geography (Country, City, State, Postal/Zip, Latitude, Longitude, Region, Continent) should have the appropriate Data Category set so map visuals and Q&A interpret them correctly.

Name: Avoid DateTime columns (split Date and Time)
Description: DateTime columns are high-cardinality and bloat the model. Where time-of-day is needed, split into a Date column and a Time column; otherwise use a Date type. Columns in a table marked as a Date table are excluded.

Name: Use singular names for tables (heuristic)
Description: Dimension/fact table names are conventionally singular (Customer, Product, Sale) rather than plural. Heuristic check: flags visible table names ending in 's' (excluding common non-plural endings such as -ss, -us, -is, -status, -analysis). Review for false positives.
Expression: IsVisible and RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)[a-rt-z]s$") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)(ss|us|is|status|analysis|series|species)$")
